latencies.notes: Data-dependent latency: 8 cycles for 0/Inf/NaN; 10 for 1 and powers of two; 23 for general inputs and max; 24 for maxsub. Measured with an integer-bit reset chain; 5 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. The sample experiment uses 1.0.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: frecip.d $f0, $f8; frecip.d $f1, $f9; frecip.d $f2, $f10; frecip.d $f3, $f11; frecip.d $f4, $f12; frecip.d $f5, $f13; frecip.d $f6, $f14; frecip.d $f7, $f15
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4' --asm 'frecip.d $f0, $f8; frecip.d $f1, $f9; frecip.d $f2, $f10; frecip.d $f3, $f11; frecip.d $f4, $f12; frecip.d $f5, $f13; frecip.d $f6, $f14; frecip.d $f7, $f15'
throughput.notes: Data-dependent throughput: CPI 4.5 for special values; 5.5 for powers of two; 12.0 for general inputs and max; 12.5 for maxsub. Throughput is initiation-interval bound.

notes: Latency 8-24 cycles and throughput CPI 4.5-12.5 are data-dependent; the stored experiments use representative operand samples.
